decisions.reason: Submitting the project through a developer verification portal does not necessarily change the approved FAQ copy, including its separate anti-scam explanation.
The warning-remediation submission does not change any mission-page content or prize-mechanics description.
Developer-portal verification is an operational warning-remediation step and does not entail a revision to the About page or its security copy.
The false-positive warning submission has no effect on ticket allocation, counting, display, or backfill rules.
Submitting the project for verification does not alter the Small Block prize amount, trigger, funding, eligibility, or reset behavior.
The developer verification portal is unrelated to Chainlink VRF selection and does not change its provider, fairness, execution, or applicable draws.
The project-verification submission does not change NFT metadata fields, reward-accounting attributes, or their source of truth.
The security-warning remediation does not affect winner announcement channels, notification channels, or email guidance.
The verification submission does not change when mint-success feedback appears or the wording of its referral variants.
Although the warning appears during wallet login, submitting the project for external verification does not alter SIWE authentication or dashboard-access behavior.
External project verification for a scam-warning false positive is distinct from Lit Protocol ownership verification and does not change ebook access rules.
The warning-remediation submission does not alter the connected-wallet USDC approval or NFT mint flow.
